profile.description: Ministral-3-8B a fast, edge-optimized AI model from the Ministral-3 family, provides robust language and multimodal vision capabilities in a compact footprint. It offers native function calling, PDF processing, and JSON output. Ministral-3-8B is fully open-source under the permissive Apache 2.0 license, which allows commercial and non-commercial use, modification, and distribution. Context window: 256K tokens.
